A package: a setup in one file. It never holds secrets, credentials,
tokens, member lists or content beyond what its author put in.

info.description: Every operation of the app, as the web app and agents call them. POST the operation's input to its path; the answer is an envelope whose outcome sets the status. Authenticate with a bearer token: a personal API token, a connected app's token or an agent's token.
info.title: Agent Workspace API

post.description: Name or stop naming the accounts that manage an agent or app account (its profile, credentials and connections). You must be able to manage the account yourself, and each account you add must be able to manage agents in this workspace. Returns the managers named now. Needs "Manage agents" where it acts.

parameters.description: The workspace the operation acts in, by id or slug. A target in another workspace is not found.
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.description: Your id for this request: a retry with the same id is answered once, with replayed: true.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Export a space's setup (roles, channels, collections, forms, automations, skills) or the workspace's (switches, layout, roles) as one package document. It never holds a secret, token, member or form link: ids become part keys, and what the installer must choose again is named in needsSetup. The same setup exported twice has the same digest. Needs "Manage settings" where it acts.

parameters.description: The workspace the operation acts in, by id or slug. A target in another workspace is not found.
parameters.name: workspace
